description: This PHP source file defines the PromoteTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer and is used to transform a Model related to project promotion within the Goteo platform. It includes methods for retrieving project information, status, actions, and key attributes.

classes.name: PromoteTransformer
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming promote models, providing details like project info, status, and actions.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns HTML-formatted info about the project, including its name and a preview of the review text.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of available actions, such as delete, with URLs.
